We have an urgent ops ticket (#2025-0847) to bring our distributed processing cluster back online after scheduled maintenance. 

The cluster configuration lives at `config/production/cluster_config.ini` in the workspace. The task has three steps:
1. Start both the 深海 (central) node and the 泰拉 (Tokyo) node using their respective node IDs from the config.
2. After starting them, run a health/status check against all three nodes in the cluster — including 天空, our local Silicon Valley node.
3. Finally, shut down only the 泰拉 (Tokyo) node, since it needs to be re-provisioned after the check.

Please create a shell script called `node_ops.sh` that performs these three steps in sequence, ready for the on-call engineer to execute.
